verifications.claim: Artemis II is currently targeted to launch no earlier than April 1, 2026, according to NASA and SpaceNews.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'potential launch date as early as April 1'; 'The launch is currently targeting April 1'. R4: 'for a launch as soon as April 1'; 'next set of launch opportunities, which begin April 1'. R5: 'crewed launch as early as Wednesday, April 1'; 'opportunity for a Wednesday, April 1, launch attempt'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the earliest launch target as April 1, 2026, aligning with 'no earlier than'; R4 is SpaceNews, others NASA-related.

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket returned to Launch Complex 39B on March 20, 2026, to prepare for Artemis II.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Just past midnight on Friday, March 20 ... carried the rocket ... to ... Pad 39B'; 'arrived at the launch pad around 9 a.m. Friday morning'. R4: 'emerged ... March 20 ... arrived at Launch Complex 39B'. R5: 'arrived at Launch Pad 39B ... on Friday, March 20'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources precisely confirm SLS rollout to Pad 39B on March 20, 2026, for Artemis II preparations.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will send four astronauts on a 10-day crewed flight around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'send four astronauts on a 10-day test flight around the moon'. R2: 'crew aboard ... around the Moon'; 'CREW SIZE | 4'. R3: 'four astronauts ... orbit the Moon on a 10-day mission'. R6: 'CREW SIZE | 4'; 'MISSION DURATION | 10 days'; 'Crewed Lunar Flyby'.
verifications.reasoning: Direct matches across sources for four astronauts, 10-day crewed lunar flyby/orbit.

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket was rolled back to the Vehicle Assembly Building (VAB) in late February 2026 to address a helium seal issue.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'returned to the VAB on Feb. 26 after a seal was found to be obstructing helium'. R4: 'rolling the rocket back to the VAB ... to fix a blockage of helium ... dislodged seal'. R5: 'arrived at the Vehicle Assembly Building (VAB) Feb. 25'; 'helium from flowing to the upper stage'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm rollback to VAB late Feb 2026 (Feb 25/26) specifically for helium seal/flow issue.

verifications.claim: The mission goal of Artemis II is a 10-day crewed test flight around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '10-day test flight around the moon'. R2: 'Artemis II test flight ... first mission with crew ... around the Moon'. R3: '10-day mission ... around the Moon'. R6: 'test flight ... first mission with crew ... around the Moon'; 'MISSION DURATION | 10 days'.
verifications.reasoning: Exact description of mission as 10-day crewed test flight around Moon in multiple sources.
